sections.title: Current Conditions
lines: Meetings occupy much of the working window.

sections.title: What’s Forming
lines: Development activity is rising while review waits lengthen and calendar space tightens. A possible review bottleneck may be forming over the next 24–48 hours.

sections.title: What We Can’t See Yet
lines: The near-term outlook has not yet been checked against real outcomes.
Review waits suggest capacity; they do not measure actual reviewer availability.
A pull request still waiting for review may ultimately wait longer.
Task size and review complexity are outside this radar.
Free calendar time does not tell us whether someone has committed to review.
How pressure differential relates to the other weather patterns remains open.

answers.question: Where am I?
answers.answer: Observatory, inside this bounded ONE reference session. Research is the one available Office.

answers.question: What changed?
answers.answer: Calendar space tightened while development activity and review waits rose. These are computed changes in the labeled source replay.

answers.question: What is it?
answers.answer: A candidate pressure differential: production activity is outpacing the review-capacity proxy.

answers.question: Why does it appear?
answers.answer: Development activity is rising. Review waits are long. Available calendar time is tight. Each contributor links to its scoped signal and extraction window.

answers.question: What did I delegate?
answers.answer: Compare the authorized Calendar/Git timing history and ask whether this has happened before. One local note, at most 4096 bytes. No further delegation or automatic follow-up.

answers.question: What did Research actually do and establish?
answers.answer: A separate readback established the commanded note bytes at that time. The objective concerns that note, not the truth of its forecast. Two timing changes are established in the replay; whether this happened earlier remains unknown.

answers.question: What remains unresolved or controllable?
answers.answer: You may withdraw future use of an admitted delegation. This control cannot reverse the earlier observed note. The forecast, actual review capacity and downstream consequences remain unestablished.

answers.question: What can I decide next?
answers.answer: You retained this finding for orientation. No subsequent work was authorized.
